event_campaign_command_council_d0c2644cd.summary: Qin's formal campaign command conference convenes at loc_kanyou. Tang Wei's campaign roster represents 176,800 friendly troops. Senior commanders physically present: Mou Gou, Ousen, Kanki, Ouki, Tou, Mou Bu, Fan Yi, Shou Hei Kun. Named supreme commander: Mou Gou. Royal-court attendees present beyond the campaign commanders: Ei Sei (sovereign), Ryo Fui (chancellor), Ri Shi (legal minister), Ketsu Shi (court political officer), Shou Bun Kun (senior veteran official), Heki (royal military officer). Supreme command issues Tang Wei this standing directive: Maintain the current lawful concentration, readiness, security, reconnaissance and command reporting. Do not cross into hostile territory until Qin issues exact war or entry authority. The conference agenda is command hierarchy, current intelligence, army assignments, routes and supply, reserve responsibilities, entry authority, and the standing order for the next campaign phase. The conference does not move armies, invent enemy knowledge, transfer troop ownership, or choose Tang Wei's protected tactics.

event_qin_command_support_2ae37c4577b99c.basis_goal: Qin Military Bureau delivers Tang Wei the current northern Wei campaign orders and force picture
event_qin_command_support_2ae37c4577b99c.summary: Qin Military Bureau briefing. Tang Wei's field command numbers 9,500 troops in 19 formation(s), currently at Kanyou. Of these, 5,000 are Qin-assigned troops and 4,500 are House or retinue troops accompanying under Tang Wei's own authority. Other Qin forces on the campaign roster: 73,200 troops in 3 formation(s), under Kanki, Mou Gou, Ousen, at Qin Capital Basin, Qin Northern Frontier, task: concentrate Mou Gou, Ousen, and Kanki field forces for the northern Wei campaign; 46,100 troops in 2 formation(s), under Ouki, Tou, at Qin Eastern March, task: concentrate Ouki and Tou field forces for the northern Wei campaign; 40,000 troops in 1 formation(s), under Mou Bu, at Qin Southern March, task: hold Mou Bu's shock army ready for the northern Wei campaign; 5,000 troops in 1 formation(s), under Fan Yi, at Qin Capital Basin, task: maintain the Qin mobile reserve as a participant in the northern Wei campaign; 3,000 troops in 1 formation(s), under Shou Hei Kun, at Qin Eastern Military Depot, task: maintain the eastern reserve as a participant in the northern Wei campaign. Combined Qin strength on the current campaign roster is 176,800. The staff designate Kanyou as the present operational area. The field command has completed its lawful staging at Kanyou; Sanyou remains the strategic target, but Qin has not yet authorized entry into Wei territory. Intelligence estimate: an official estimate of roughly 94,000-156,000 troops able to influence the theater; reported opposing commanders: Deng Shan, Gai Mou, Go Hou Mei, Huan Zhen, Jing Ning, Jing Rong, Luo Qian, Qiao He, Qiao Jie, Rei Ou; no confirmed battle contact. These are staff estimates rather than confirmed enemy counts. The Bureau's standing orders record concentration at Kanyou as complete. Further advance into Wei territory awaits new lawful entry authority.
